versions.changelog:
Initial release of open-leqi-assistant.

- Provides project architecture overview and code location guide for the 乐企(open-leqi) digital platform.
- Supports quick navigation to core modules: invoice management, deduction selection, and ticket issuance interfaces.
- Includes detailed mapping tables of Controller, Service, and Client classes for main business domains.
- Offers code search patterns, business flow scenarios, naming conventions, and API standards.
- Adds references for project structure, business processes, and API guides.
